metric_inputs: Retained per-clip CLAP and per-system FAD values used in the manuscript statistical analyses. Original audio-to-metric computation is not reconstructed; the historical FAD reference-track manifest is unavailable.
clip_means: The published three-decimal clip means are preserved for analyses originally using them; exact means are reaggregated from ratings for the analyses originally using exact means.
distribution_metrics_selection: Retained model and fad_score columns without changing the numeric literals; unused mad_score omitted.
